Container.Name: pinebridge-bridge
Container.Overview: Pinebridge: TradingView alerts to MetaTrader 5. Send TradingView alerts straight to MetaTrader 5 on your own Unraid server. No paid signal-relay service, no VPS. This container receives the TradingView webhook alerts and passes them over ZeroMQ to the Expert Advisor in pinebridge-mt5. Needs pinebridge-mt5 running alongside it; the webhook secret is generated for you.
Container.DonateText: If Pinebridge saves you a VPS or signal subscription, consider buying me a coffee.
Container.Requires: Install pinebridge-mt5 too. The defaults work as-is on Unraid's default bridge network. Leave WEBHOOK_SECRET blank to have one generated; your TradingView webhook URL is printed in this container's log on first start.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the webhook. Point your Cloudflare tunnel at http://[your Unraid IP]:[this port].

Config.Name: ZMQ_HOST
Config.Description: Where the EA's ZeroMQ port is reachable. 172.17.0.1 (the Docker host on the default bridge network) works when pinebridge-mt5 runs on this server; otherwise use that server's LAN IP.

Config.Name: ZMQ_PORT
Config.Description: ZeroMQ PULL port the EA listens on

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: Leave blank to generate one on first start (saved in the Config path as webhook_secret, and the full webhook URL is printed in the log). Or set your own long random string.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Optional: your tunnel's https address (e.g. https://tv-webhook.example.com), so the log prints the exact TradingView webhook URL.

Config.Name: REQUIRE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: Leave true for anything reachable from the internet. Only set false for local-only testing.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Keeps the generated webhook secret across restarts and updates
